target_template_check.blocker: q38.jinja renders tool calls with `{% for args_name, args_value in tool_call.arguments|items %}`. phase1_sft.jsonl stores function.arguments as a JSON *string* (OpenAI wire format), so apply_chat_template raises TypeError: 'Can only get item pairs from a mapping.' on 100% of rows (all 202 have tool_calls). Axolotl's chat_template dataset type calls the same tokenizer template -> the real 27B run would fail at dataset-prep time.
target_template_check.fix: parse function.arguments from JSON string to dict; fixed copy written to trainability/phase1_sft_dictargs.jsonl (680 tool-call argument objects converted, 0 unparseable). After the fix all 202/202 rows render.
target_template_check.note_thinking:
q38.jinja gates the assistant <think> block on `preserve_thinking is undefined or preserve_thinking is true or loop.index0 > ns.last_query_index` -> with defaults EVERY assistant turn renders as '<|im_start|>assistant
<think>

</think>

' + content, which matches the enable_thinking=false generation prompt. No train/inference drift on the real target.
target_template_check.note_tool_role: q38.jinja emits tool results inside a '<|im_start|>user ... <tool_response>' block and uses XML tool calls (<tool_call><function=name><parameter=x>), not the JSON <tool_call> form used by Qwen3-0.6B. Both families support tools; the surface form differs.

token_lengths_under_q38.comment: sequence_len: 16384 in axolotl_lora_q38_27b.yaml is ample; nothing is truncated. The 2048 cap in this micro-run is a task constraint, not a config concern.

fallback_template_caveat:
Qwen3-0.6B's template injects '<think>

</think>

' only on a TRAILING assistant message (loop.last) or when reasoning_content is set, so mid-conversation assistant turns render without it while the enable_thinking=False generation prompt contains it. This is a Qwen3-0.6B-only artifact; q38.jinja does not have it.
masking_method: incremental prefix rendering with a sentinel user message appended to every prefix, so template branches keyed on 'last message is assistant' never fire and prefixes stay strictly monotone; asserted token-prefix consistency and strict monotonicity at every boundary. The system turn's start is pinned to 0 (rendering an empty prefix is not comparable: Qwen templates synthesize a default system block when none is present). The '<|im_start|>assistant\n' header stays masked; content + <|im_end|> are trained (== axolotl train_on_eos: turn).
